# test08_fedavg_skewed_s19

A complete NVFLARE job. Every module the hospitals import is inside
`app/custom/`, so nothing is read from this repository while it runs.

## What is in the folder

```
test08_fedavg_skewed_s19/
├── meta.json                             name, min_clients, deploy_map
└── app/
    ├── config/config_fed_server.json     controller, rounds, model selector
    ├── config/config_fed_client.json     executor and the client command line
    └── custom/                           the code that runs at each hospital
        ├── federation/client.py
        ├── config/  common/  core/
        └── dataset_config.py
```

## What it runs

| | |
|---|---|
| algorithm | FedAvg |
| hospitals | 4 |
| partition | `4_clients_skewed_s19` |
| rounds x local epochs | 30 x 1 |
| model selection | `val_balanced_accuracy`, on held-out client patients |
| model | `resnet18`, ImageNet-pretrained, 3 classes |
| frozen | `layer3` and every layer before it |
| input | 224x224 RGB, three DCE phases fused |
| optimiser | adamw, lr 0.0001, weight decay 0.0005 |
| regularisation | dropout 0.5, label smoothing 0.1, gradient clip 1.0 |
| batch size | 24, at most 1 slice per patient |
| class weights | inverse frequency per patient, scope `local` |
| seed | 19 |

FedAvg (McMahan et al., 2017). The server averages the client updates, weighting each one by how much data that site trained on.

## Data

Patients are split by patient, never by slice. Every image of a patient goes to one hospital, and no patient appears at two sites.

| hospital | share of training patients | ratio |
|---|---:|---:|
| `hospital_1` | 55.6% | 5 |
| `hospital_2` | 22.2% | 2 |
| `hospital_3` | 11.1% | 1 |
| `hospital_4` | 11.1% | 1 |

Every hospital keeps the global class ratio, so the hospitals differ only in how much data they hold. Each hospital also holds back 20% of its own patients as a local validation split, which is what produces the metric the server selects on.

The files are in `deployment/data/partitions/4_clients_skewed_s19/<hospital>/`.

## How to run it

Start the federation with 4 hospitals, open the admin
console, and submit the job by name:

```
submit_job test08_fedavg_skewed_s19
```

`submit_job` looks names up in the admin's own `transfer/` directory.
`generate_jobs.py` copies this folder there, so the name is enough.

The scripted equivalent, which also writes `job.json` and the admin log:

```bash
python deployment/code/scripts/run_experiment.py test08_s19
```
